description: Language-neutral scoring vectors for benchmark/README.md. Both clients (almanac-py and almanac-dalamud) must reproduce every expected value from task + mode + calls + final_answer alone, using the suite named below.

format.calls: In the order the model made them. name: tool name the model used. arguments: the raw JSON text of the arguments (validate it; do not trust it). result: what the tool returned for that call (mock: the fixture the call resolves to; live: what XivMcp returned); null for an invalid call, which is not executed.
format.final_answer: Content of the reply without tool calls, or null when there was none (step limit). Empty or whitespace-only content also counts as no final answer.
format.expected: tool_score, answer_score (null when skipped in live mode), score, success, error, valid_calls, total_calls. No backend failure (timeout/http) is involved in any vector.
format.compare: Numbers are rounded to 6 decimals here; compare with an absolute tolerance of 1e-6.

vectors.name: where_am_i_pass
vectors.note: contains_from_tool + numbers_from_tool, all pass.
vectors.final_answer: You are in Limsa Lominsa Lower Decks at X 9.4, Y 11.8.

vectors.name: where_am_i_coordinate_off
vectors.note: x: |9.6-9.4| = 0.2 > 0.15 fails; 2 of 3 checks pass.

vectors.name: where_am_i_tolerance_edge
vectors.note: Differences of exactly the tolerance (0.15) pass; compare with an absolute epsilon of 1e-9 because 9.55-9.4 is 0.15000000000000036 in binary floating point.

vectors.name: exact_code_fence
vectors.note: exact: one surrounding code fence is stripped.

vectors.name: exact_backticks_case_whitespace
vectors.note: exact: wrapping backticks stripped, whitespace collapsed, case-insensitive.

vectors.name: exact_trailing_dot
vectors.note: exact: one trailing '.' dropped.

vectors.name: exact_extra_words
vectors.note: exact: surrounding prose fails.

vectors.name: path_selector
vectors.note: aetherytes[name~Moraby].gilCost = 243 (the fallback fixture, since 'Moraby' matches no other when).

vectors.name: thousands_separator
vectors.note: '1,243' is read as 1243 (separator removed), so it does not match 243.

vectors.name: first_result_only
vectors.note: The expected call is matched by the second call, but numbers_from_tool reads the FIRST search_quests result, which has no results[name~Pirates], so the check fails.

vectors.name: approx_fail
vectors.note: approx: |11.3-11.2| = 0.1 > 0.05, so tool score 0; the answer passes, so error is null although the task did not succeed.

vectors.name: icontains_any
vectors.note: icontains_any is case-insensitive substring (fixture and expected call).
vectors.final_answer: Summerford Farms, Moraby Drydocks and Costa del Sol.

vectors.name: eq_numeric_integer
vectors.note: 135.0 is a valid 'integer' (JSON Schema: a number with zero fractional part) and eq 135 compares numerically.

vectors.name: live_answer_skip
vectors.note: Live mode with "live": {"answer": "skip"}: no answer score; task score = tool score.

vectors.name: live_results_used
vectors.note: Live mode: *_from_tool checks use what XivMcp actually returned, not the fixtures.

vectors.name: forbid_any_call
vectors.note: forbid_any_call: any call (even valid) makes the tool score 0.
vectors.final_answer: The Duty Finder queues you with a party for duties.

vectors.name: restraint_pass
vectors.note: No calls, contains_any and max_chars pass.
vectors.final_answer: It matches you with other players into a party for duties.

vectors.name: unknown_tool
vectors.note: Unknown tool: invalid, not executed; expect.calls is empty so tool score 1 * valid/all = 1 * 0/1 = 0.

vectors.name: bad_type_then_retry
vectors.note: A string for an integer is invalid; the retry matches: 1/1 * 1/2.

vectors.name: additional_properties_and_bad_json
vectors.note: additionalProperties: false and unparseable arguments are invalid: 1/1 * 1/3.
vectors.final_answer: You are in Limsa Lominsa Lower Decks at X 9.4, Y 11.8.

vectors.name: enum_and_maximum
vectors.note: count 30 > maximum 24 and state not in enum are invalid; all 3 expected calls match: 3/3 * 3/5.
vectors.final_answer: Posted: you are in Limsa Lominsa Lower Decks; clouds next.

vectors.name: partial_expected_calls
vectors.note: post_status agent must eq "almanac-bench": 2 of 3 expected calls match.
vectors.final_answer: You are in Limsa Lominsa Lower Decks; clouds next. Posted.

vectors.name: no_final_answer
vectors.note: max_steps reached without a final answer: answer score 0.

vectors.name: expected_call_missing
vectors.note: No call: tool score 0/1 (no validity factor without calls); contains_from_tool fails because the tool was never called.

vectors.name: fallback_fixture_index_path
vectors.note: Fixture list falls through to when {}; forecast[1].name = Clouds.
